title: Clarifying How the Recycle Bin Works for a team

question.author: member_143
question.body: Before I explain how the recycle bin works to my team, what should I verify in the official guide?

answers.author: cloudbox_support
answers.body: The current Recycle Bin and Deletion documentation says: Items in the recycle bin do not count against your storage quota, but they remain visible to anyone who had access to the original item's folder. When you delete a file or folder in any CloudBox client, it moves to the recycle bin instead of being destroyed. Restoring an item returns it to its original location with its sharing settings intact. That official page is the source to follow if a community reply describes an older version. Check the complete section there for surrounding conditions before applying it to your case.
